guard: the send end-to-end smoke runs the repository's real bin/cotal.ts entry against its explicitly owned broker
why: The prior URL walked only to implementations/ and attempted implementations/bin/cotal.ts. Every delivery assertion was unreachable, and the suite stayed ungated.

The named precondition proves the subprocess entry exists before any command runs. The owned OS-assigned broker, isolated two-entry registry, explicit current selection, and neutral subprocess cwd make the no-flag CLI path safe to run in CI and concurrently without borrowing an ambient mesh.

mutations.name: resolve the CLI from implementations/bin again
mutations.expectRed: the subprocess entry is the repository's real bin/cotal.ts
mutations.cell: the subprocess entry is the repository's real bin/cotal.ts

mutations.name: the sandbox registry selects the decoy mesh as current

mutations.cell: `cotal send dm` outside a seat exits 0

mutations.name: restore the obsolete managed-seat environment gate
mutations.expectRed: `cotal send dm` outside a seat exits 0
mutations.cell: `cotal send dm` outside a seat exits 0

mutations.cell: seat-shaped environment cannot replace the credential-derived principal
